method: Actual candidate module functions with complete pinned file fixtures; browser fetch transport simulated, no UI/browser test.

tests.name: Cold store reads only one index and selected phase; cache reuse makes no second request
All seven empty phases load their original raw metadata
Original phase IDs with spaces are preserved and resolved through index files
Phase summaries preserve source zero year and missing NGA without assigning map geography
A supplied file path on a polity object is ignored; traversal and external index files are rejected
Wrong versions, duplicate phase IDs, altered totals and missing source headers fail closed
Source identity uses sheet+row, rejecting duplicates, renamed variables and coerced booleans
Transport validates raw gzip and HTTP-decoded JSON against pinned hashes
HTTP errors, caller cancellation, invalid JSON and request timeout remain retryable
A bad shard is not cached, and a retry reloads its valid original
An aborted read cannot populate cache when its loader ignores abort
Clearing a store invalidates an in-flight response and allows a fresh read
Synchronous cache invalidation obsoletes all public operations suspended on a cached index
Clearing between verified transport and caller continuation cannot repopulate any cache
Versioned stores have independent bounded phase caches
Crisis cards retain coded outcomes, null flags and beyond-phase dates
Full-search source integrity rejects duplicate source rows even if count matches
Source values and numeric endpoint comparisons preserve precision and do not infer ranges
Undated rows retain null dates and phase context regardless of a map-year filter
Record exports retain exact original rows, cell types, IDs and snapshot provenance
Domain and variable search request only relevant source sheets and retain one page
Crisis search is one lazy source sheet; requested page and filtered downloads agree
Cancelled progressive searches do not return partial success or continue to more sheets
Failed multi-sheet search rejects; retry completes and search LRU stays bounded
Only supported domains/variables and bounded query text enter filtering
All six search sheets remain searchable, with full count and bounded retained page/cache
Every preserved anomaly renders as source context without changing raw dates or endpoints
